dedupe_keys.name: london public realm trees about 1 14 million trees with 2090 climate suitability

description: Locations, species and future climate suitability for almost 1,140,000 public realm trees in London, used for the London Public Realm Tree Map. It covers mainly street trees and trees in parks and open spaces, plus some on school grounds and publicly maintained housing land. GiGL collated inventories from all 32 boroughs, the City of London, Transport for London, the Royal Parks, the Olympic Park and Wembley Park; the map was first published in 2016, updated in 2021 and May 2025, and a December 2025 update added 2090 climate suitability scores and tree location types. Coverage: Greater London public realm trees, not the eight million or more trees in the whole urban forest. Access: CSV downloads, the latest from November 2025 at about 199 MB. Licence: Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: records are direct extracts from borough inventories, some several years old, location is missing for some records and three boroughs, and content varies by borough. Simulation uses: tree inventories for heat, shading, stormwater and species climate risk studies. Related records: the NYC 2015 Street Tree Census and Treepedia.
